messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Deployment fails but app works
parts:
Maria,

Could you try adding library(gpclib) to your code? I suspect the issue is that gpclib is a suggested package, which means it is not automatically-installed. By adding the library() call, shiny apps will detect it as a required package and install it.

-Andy
